scenarioStory.history: Patient delivered a healthy full-term infant at home approximately 30 minutes ago with the assistance of family; no midwife or EMS present for the delivery itself. Placenta delivered spontaneously about 10 minutes after the infant. Family reports steadily worsening vaginal bleeding since placental delivery, soaking through multiple towels. Patient reports feeling increasingly dizzy and weak since the bleeding started.
scenarioStory.course: Initial Contact: Crew arrives to find a 27-year-old female approximately 30 minutes postpartum with a healthy newborn on her chest and ongoing heavy vaginal bleeding soaking through towels. She is alert but reports dizziness and weakness. → Fundal massage and IV fluids started: Crew performs fundal massage, obtains OB and bleeding history, establishes IV access, and initiates a fluid bolus while continuously reassessing for improvement in bleeding and perfusion. → Bleeding controlled, transport initiated: Fundal massage and fluid resuscitation improve uterine tone; bleeding slows significantly and vital signs trend toward normal. Mother and newborn are packaged together for transport with continued reassessment.

patientInformation.patientCondition: Continued heavy vaginal bleeding after home delivery 30 minutes ago

scenarioEvents.name: Initial Contact
scenarioEvents.description: Crew arrives to find a 27-year-old female approximately 30 minutes postpartum with a healthy newborn on her chest and ongoing heavy vaginal bleeding soaking through towels. She is alert but reports dizziness and weakness.

scenarioEvents.name: Fundal massage and IV fluids started
scenarioEvents.description: Crew performs fundal massage, obtains OB and bleeding history, establishes IV access, and initiates a fluid bolus while continuously reassessing for improvement in bleeding and perfusion.
relatedChecklist: Perform fundal massage to promote uterine contraction and control bleeding
Obtain OB history: prenatal/delivery complications, trauma, anticoagulants, drug use
Establish IV access; if unsuccessful within 2 attempts/90 seconds, place IO
Initiate 500 mL isotonic fluid bolus toward MAP goal 65 mmHg (max 30 mL/kg ≈ 2,040 mL for 68 kg)
Notify medical direction/receiving facility of postpartum hemorrhage

scenarioEvents.name: Bleeding controlled, transport initiated
scenarioEvents.description: Fundal massage and fluid resuscitation improve uterine tone; bleeding slows significantly and vital signs trend toward normal. Mother and newborn are packaged together for transport with continued reassessment.
relatedChecklist: Contain placenta and tissue in a plastic bag for hospital evaluation
Reassess vital signs and estimate total blood loss en route

scenarioEvents.name: Fundal massage omitted or delayed
scenarioEvents.description: Without fundal massage, the uterus remains boggy and atonic. Bleeding continues unchecked, and the patient progresses toward hypovolemic shock despite IV fluids.
relatedChecklist: Recognize hypovolemic shock; perform fundal massage now and escalate fluid boluses toward MAP 65 mmHg
Consider TXA administration per medical direction (MATC does not specify a dose)
